episodes.title: Mochi's Yummy Surprise
episodes.summary: Zizi brings sandwiches for a picnic and reminds Mochi to say Bismillah before eating.

guide.before: Ask: what do we say before we eat?
talk: What did Zizi remind Mochi to say?
Why do you think we say Bismillah before eating?
What else can we say Bismillah before?

activity.title: Bismillah placemat
activity.text: Draw your favourite food on a paper placemat and write "Bismillah" at the top. Use it at the next meal.

guide.remember: I say Bismillah before I eat.

episodes.title: Torasan & The Gift of Salam
episodes.summary: Torasan teaches Zizi the meaning of "Assalamu Alaikum" and the sunnah of greeting others.

guide.before: Ask: how do we greet people when we see them?
talk: What does "Assalamu Alaikum" mean?
How did Zizi feel when she gave salam?
Who can you give salam to today?

activity.title: Salam challenge
activity.text: Count how many people you greet with salam today. Put a sticker on a chart for each one.

guide.remember: Salam is a gift of peace.

episodes.title: Zizi's Big Feelings
episodes.summary: Zizi feels very angry and learns to calm down by sitting, then lying down, following the Prophet's ﷺ advice.

guide.before: Ask: what does your body feel like when you're angry?
talk: What made Zizi so angry?
What did Zizi do to calm down?
What can you do next time you feel angry?

activity.title: Calm-down corner
activity.text: Choose a cosy spot at home with a cushion. Practise: sit down, take three slow breaths, then lie down if you still feel cross.

guide.remember: When I'm angry, I sit down and breathe.

episodes.title: Telling The Truth
episodes.summary: Zizi and Mochi accidentally stain Torasan's scroll and must decide: hide it, or tell the truth?

guide.before: Ask: have you ever broken something by accident?
talk: What happened to Torasan's scroll?
Why was it hard for Zizi and Mochi to tell the truth?
How did they feel after they told him?

activity.title: Brave truth jar
activity.text: Each time someone in the family tells a hard truth this week, add a pom-pom or button to a jar.

guide.remember: Telling the truth makes my heart feel light.

episodes.title: Kaji Forgets His Manners
episodes.summary: Upset about a lost toy, Kaji is rude to Zizi, who gently reminds him to keep good manners even when upset.

guide.before: Ask: is it easy to be kind when we're upset?
talk: Why was Kaji upset?
How did Zizi feel when Kaji was rude?
What kind words could Kaji have used instead?

activity.title: Kind words swap
activity.text: Take turns saying an unkind sentence in a silly voice, and the other person turns it into kind words.

guide.remember: Even when I'm upset, I use kind words.

episodes.title: Zizi Falls Sick
episodes.summary: When Zizi falls ill, Mochi looks after her, remembering the Prophet's ﷺ teaching about visiting the sick.

guide.before: Ask: how do you feel when you're poorly?
talk: How did Mochi help Zizi feel better?
Why is visiting someone who is sick a good deed?
Who could we check on this week?

activity.title: Get-well card
activity.text: Make a card for someone who is unwell, or for a grandparent, and deliver or post it together.

guide.remember: I care for friends when they are sick.

episodes.title: Zizi Helps Tanuki
episodes.summary: Tanuki's vegetables are in trouble, and Zizi steps in to help.

guide.before: Ask: what does it mean to help someone?
talk: What was Tanuki's problem?
How did Zizi help?
How do you think Tanuki felt afterwards?

activity.title: Little helper job
activity.text: Pick one helping job to do at home today, like watering plants or setting the table.

guide.remember: I help when someone needs it.

episodes.title: Zizi Learns To Share
episodes.summary: Zizi's block tower tumbles after Mochi joins in, and she learns about sharing.

guide.before: Ask: is it easy or hard to share your toys?
talk: Why didn't Zizi want to share at first?
What happened to the tower?
How can we share and still have fun?

activity.title: Tower for two
activity.text: Build a block tower together, taking turns to add one block each. See how tall you can go.

guide.remember: Sharing makes play more fun.

episodes.title: Kaji Learns About Trust
episodes.summary: Kaji's pranks make his friends stop believing him, and Torasan teaches him about honesty.

guide.before: Ask: what does it mean to trust someone?
talk: Why did the friends stop believing Kaji?
What did Torasan teach him?
How can Kaji earn his friends' trust again?

activity.title: Trust walk
activity.text: One person closes their eyes while the other gently guides them across the room. Swap. Talk about how trust felt.

guide.remember: When I tell the truth, people can trust me.

episodes.title: Tanuki's Garden
episodes.summary: Zizi and Mochi help Tanuki on his farm and discover that food tastes better after hard work.

guide.before: Ask: where does our food come from?
talk: What jobs did Zizi and Mochi do on the farm?
Why did the food taste so good at the end?
Who works hard to bring us our food?

activity.title: Grow a seed
activity.text: Plant a bean or cress seed in a cup. Water it each day and say Alhamdulillah when it sprouts.

guide.remember: Hard work and Alhamdulillah go together.

episodes.title: Mochi Eats Too Much
episodes.summary: Mochi eats too many dumplings, gets a tummy ache and learns about moderation.

guide.before: Ask: what happens if we eat too much?
talk: Why did Mochi's tummy hurt?
How do we know when we've had enough?
What could Mochi do differently next time?

activity.title: Thirds plate
activity.text: Draw a plate split into three: a part for food, a part for drink, and an empty part for air. Talk about leaving space.

guide.remember: I eat until I'm happy, not too full.

episodes.title: The Muddy Adventure
episodes.summary: Zizi and friends set off on an adventure that turns very muddy.

guide.before: Ask: have you ever got really muddy?
talk: What happened on the muddy adventure?
How did the friends help each other?
What lesson did they learn?

activity.title: Draw the adventure
activity.text: Draw your favourite part of the story and tell someone what happened.

guide.remember: Good friends help each other.

episodes.title: Kaji Can't Sleep
episodes.summary: Kaji can't fall asleep, so Torasan teaches him a bedtime dua and Ayat al-Kursi.

guide.before: Ask: what helps you fall asleep?
talk: Why couldn't Kaji sleep?
What did Torasan teach him to say?
What is your bedtime routine?

activity.title: Bedtime routine card
activity.text: Draw your bedtime steps (brush teeth, wudhu, dua, sleep) on a card and keep it by the bed.

guide.remember: I remember Allah before I sleep.

episodes.title: The Kite Chase
episodes.summary: Zizi's kite blows away and lands on top of the masjid's minaret.

guide.before: Ask: have you ever lost something you love?
talk: Where did the kite end up?
How did Zizi feel when it blew away?
Who helped get it back?

activity.title: Paper kite
activity.text: Make a small kite from paper, string and a straw, and fly it together outside.

guide.remember: When things go wrong, I stay calm and ask for help.

episodes.title: The Farmers' Market
episodes.summary: Zizi, Mochi and Kaji spend a day at the market and learn about gratitude and good manners.

guide.before: Ask: what do we say when someone gives us something?
talk: What did the friends see at the market?
Who did they say thank you to?
What are you thankful for today?

activity.title: Play market
activity.text: Set up a pretend market stall with fruit or toys. Practise please, thank you and Jazakallahu khairan.

guide.remember: I say thank you and Alhamdulillah.

episodes.title: The Bamboo Target
episodes.summary: Zizi and Mochi practise archery and learn that steady, patient effort builds success.

guide.before: Ask: what is something that was hard at first but got easier?
talk: Did Zizi hit the target the first time?
What helped her get better?
What would you like to keep practising?

activity.title: Sock toss
activity.text: Roll up socks and throw them into a basket. Count how many land in, then try again and see if you improve.

guide.remember: Little by little, I get better.

episodes.title: The Raft Race
episodes.summary: Zizi, Mochi and Kaji race homemade rafts and learn about humility and teamwork.

guide.before: Ask: how do you feel when you win, or lose, a game?
talk: Who wanted to win the most?
What happened when they worked together?
What should we say to a friend who loses?

activity.title: Boat in the bath
activity.text: Build a little boat from a sponge or cork and test which one floats best. Cheer for every boat.

guide.remember: Winning or losing, I stay kind and humble.

episodes.title: The Treasure of Shukr
episodes.summary: Zizi searches for a "real treasure" and, with Mochi and Torasan, discovers gratitude.

guide.before: Ask: what is the most precious thing you have?
talk: What treasure was Zizi looking for?
What did she find instead?
What does "shukr" mean?

activity.title: Shukr treasure box
activity.text: Decorate a box. Each night, add a small note or drawing of one thing you're thankful for.

guide.remember: Alhamdulillah for all my blessings.

episodes.title: The Little Sparrow's Rescue
episodes.summary: Zizi and Mochi find an injured sparrow and learn about gentleness and mercy.

guide.before: Ask: how should we treat animals?
talk: What happened to the little sparrow?
How did Zizi and Mochi help it?
How can we be gentle with animals at home or outside?

activity.title: Bird feeder
activity.text: Make a simple feeder with a pine cone, a little nut-free spread and birdseed. Hang it outside and watch who visits.

guide.remember: I am gentle and merciful to animals.

episodes.title: A Journey To Dreamland
episodes.summary: Zaynab flies to Dreamland with Buzzbee, catches a cold, and learns about honey and everyday Islamic phrases.

guide.before: Ask: what words do we say every day, like Bismillah?
talk: Where did Zaynab and Buzzbee go?
What helped Zaynab when she had a cold?
Which special words did she use?

activity.title: Phrase match
activity.text: Write Bismillah, Alhamdulillah, InshaAllah and MashaAllah on cards. Take turns acting out when we say each one.

guide.remember: I remember Allah with little words every day.

episodes.title: The Lost Book
episodes.summary: Kuku the owl's favourite book goes missing, and Zaynab and Buzzbee search the library to find it.

guide.before: Ask: how do you feel when you can't find something?
talk: What did Kuku lose?
How did Zaynab and Buzzbee help?
Where do you keep your favourite books?

activity.title: Book hunt
activity.text: Hide a favourite book somewhere at home and give clues to find it. Then read it together.

guide.remember: I help my friends when they need me.

episodes.title: The Garden of Salam
episodes.summary: A garden has lost its life because people stopped greeting each other. Zaynab spreads salam and it blooms again.

guide.before: Ask: how do you feel when someone smiles and says salam?
talk: Why was the garden sad and grey?
What did Zaynab do to make it bloom?
Who can we give salam to this week?

activity.title: Salam flower
activity.text: Draw a flower with empty petals. Colour in one petal each time you give salam.

guide.remember: Salam makes hearts bloom.

episodes.title: The Cloud of Feelings
episodes.summary: A dark cloud follows Zaynab when she's upset. Deep breaths, dhikr and forgiveness help clear it.

guide.before: Ask: what colour would your feelings be today?
talk: Why did the cloud follow Zaynab?
What helped the cloud go away?
What can you do when you feel a grey cloud?

activity.title: Cloud breathing
activity.text: Draw a cloud. Breathe in slowly, breathe out and say SubhanAllah. Repeat three times and colour the cloud lighter.

guide.remember: Breathe, remember Allah, and forgive.

episodes.title: The Lanterns of Kindness
episodes.summary: The lanterns in the Valley of Lanterns grow dim, and kind words help them shine again.

guide.before: Ask: what is a kind word you like to hear?
talk: Why were the lanterns going dim?
What made them shine again?
What kind words can you say today?

activity.title: Kindness lantern
activity.text: Make a paper lantern. Write a kind word on each side and hang it in your room.

guide.remember: Kind words make the world brighter.

episodes.title: The Tree of Patience
episodes.summary: A tree grows taller each time Zaynab reaches for its fruit. Kuku teaches her about sabr and dhikr.

guide.before: Ask: is it hard to wait for something you want?
talk: What happened every time Zaynab reached for the fruit?
What did Kuku teach her?
What can we say while we wait?

activity.title: Waiting game
activity.text: Set a sand timer or count to 30 while saying SubhanAllah before a treat. Talk about how waiting felt.

guide.remember: I wait with sabr and remember Allah.

episodes.title: The Echoing Cave
episodes.summary: A cave repeats every word Zaynab and Buzzbee say, and Zaynab learns that our words always come back to us.

guide.before: Ask: have you ever heard an echo?
talk: What did the cave do with their words?
Why should we choose our words carefully?
What kind words would you like to come back to you?

activity.title: Echo game
activity.text: Take turns saying a kind sentence and having the other person echo it back. Notice how it feels.

guide.remember: My words come back to me, so I choose kind ones.

episodes.title: The Lost Baby Quail
episodes.summary: Zaynab and Buzzbee help a lost baby quail find her mama, with help from Fu-Fu the butterfly and Hoppity the grasshopper.

guide.before: Ask: what should you do if you ever get lost?
talk: How did the baby quail feel when she was lost?
Who helped her find her mama?
What should we do if we see someone who needs help?

activity.title: Safe grown-ups
activity.text: Talk about who your safe grown-ups are, and practise saying your family name and a grown-up's phone number.

guide.remember: I help others, and I know who keeps me safe.

episodes.title: The Fountain of Wudhu
episodes.summary: On the way to the masjid, a glowing fountain teaches Zaynab and Buzzbee how to make wudhu.

guide.before: Ask: what do we do before we pray?
talk: What did the fountain teach Zaynab?
Which parts do we wash in wudhu?
How do you feel after making wudhu?

activity.title: Wudhu steps
activity.text: Practise wudhu together at the sink, naming each step out loud. Draw the steps as a little chart.

guide.remember: Wudhu makes me clean and ready to pray.

episodes.title: The Barakah Basket
episodes.summary: Zaynab decides whether to share her bread roll with sleepy Snoozy the bear, and her basket fills with more.

guide.before: Ask: what does barakah mean?
talk: What did Zaynab share with Snoozy?
What happened to her basket afterwards?
What could you share with someone this week?

activity.title: Sharing basket
activity.text: Fill a small basket with snacks or fruit and share it with family, neighbours or friends.

guide.remember: When I share, Allah puts barakah in it.

episodes.title: The Beauty of Good Character
episodes.summary: Zaynab reminds two quarrelling rosellas about good manners and kindness to family.

guide.before: Ask: what does good character mean to you?
talk: Why were the rosellas arguing?
What did Zaynab remind them?
How can we be kind to our brothers, sisters and cousins?

activity.title: Kindness to family
activity.text: Do one secret kind thing for someone in your family today, and see if they notice.

guide.remember: Good character starts at home.

episodes.title: The Truthful Glowberries
episodes.summary: Glowberries shine with truth. When Tobi hides one for himself, its glow fades, and the friends learn about honesty.

guide.before: Ask: how do you feel inside when you tell the truth?
talk: What happened to the glowberry Tobi hid?
How did Tobi make things right?
Why does honesty make us shine?

activity.title: Glow jar
activity.text: Fill a jar with a torch or fairy lights. Switch it on together whenever someone tells the truth about something hard.

guide.remember: Honesty makes my heart glow.

episodes.title: The Bridge of Friendship
episodes.summary: An argument broke the old bridge between the squirrels and beavers. Zaynab helps rebuild it, and their friendship.

guide.before: Ask: have you ever had an argument with a friend?
talk: Why was the bridge broken?
How did Zaynab help the squirrels and beavers?
How can we make up after an argument?

activity.title: Build a bridge
activity.text: Build a bridge from blocks, lolly sticks or books between two "islands". Say sorry and forgive while you build.

guide.remember: Saying sorry builds bridges.

episodes.title: The Rainbow of Emotions
episodes.summary: Feeling overwhelmed, Zaynab finds a rainbow behind a waterfall that helps her name each feeling.

guide.before: Ask: can you name a feeling you had today?
talk: What colours were in the rainbow?
Which feeling did each colour show?
Which colour are you feeling right now?

activity.title: Feelings rainbow
activity.text: Draw a rainbow and label each stripe with a feeling. Point to how you feel each morning this week.

guide.remember: All feelings are okay. I can name them.

episodes.title: The Beauty of Sincere Effort
episodes.summary: Zaynab's sand masjid keeps collapsing. With Buzzbee and Kuku, she learns about patience and trusting Allah.

guide.before: Ask: what do you do when something keeps going wrong?
talk: What kept happening to Zaynab's sand masjid?
What did Kuku teach her about trying?
What does it mean to trust Allah?

activity.title: Try-again tower
activity.text: Build a tower from cups or blocks. Every time it falls, say "InshaAllah" and try again together.

guide.remember: I try my best and trust Allah with the rest.

episodes.title: Why Won't My Seed Grow?
episodes.summary: Maryam and her friends plant their own seeds. With a little guidance from Uncle Hadi, they discover that growing takes care, patience and time.

guide.before: Ask: have you ever waited for something to grow?
talk: Why did Maryam feel worried when her seed didn't come up straight away?
What did the friends do each day to look after their seeds?
Zaynab's seed hadn't come up yet. Why is it okay to grow at our own pace?

activity.title: Grow a seed together
activity.text: With a grown-up's help, plant a bean or cress seed in a cup. Water it a little each day, draw how it looks, and say Alhamdulillah when the first green shoot appears.

guide.remember: I do my part, I am patient, and I trust Allah.

episodes.title: Haya Forgets to Say Thank You
episodes.summary: Uncle Bilal fixes Haya's wobbly bicycle wheel. She says Alhamdulillah and rushes off to Qur'an class, but forgets to thank the person who helped her.

guide.before: Ask: who helped you today?
talk: Who helped you today? Did you get a chance to thank them?
Haya said “Alhamdulillah”. Why did she still go back to Uncle Bilal?
How do you think Uncle Bilal felt when Haya came back?

activity.title: Thank-you card
activity.text: Make a thank-you card for someone who helped your family this week. At dinner, take turns naming one person to thank and one blessing to say Alhamdulillah for.

guide.remember: I thank Allah, and I thank the people who help me.

episodes.title: Zaynab and the Rainy Day
episodes.summary: Rain spoils Zaynab's sunny day at the park, until her mum's gentle reminder of the Prophet's ﷺ wisdom helps her turn disappointment into gratitude.

guide.before: Ask: what do you do when plans change?
talk: How did Zaynab feel when the rain came?
What did her mum remind her about the rain?
What can we still be thankful for on a rainy day?

activity.title: Rainy day thank-yous
activity.text: Next time it rains, look out of the window together and name three good things the rain brings, like flowers, food and water to drink.

guide.remember: When plans change, I still say Alhamdulillah.

episodes.title: Aminah's Night Light
episodes.summary: Aminah is scared of the dark, until her mum teaches her to recite Ayat al-Kursi before bed.

guide.before: Ask: what helps you feel safe at bedtime?
talk: Why was Aminah scared at night?
What did her mum teach her to recite before sleeping?
How did Aminah feel after remembering Allah?

activity.title: Bedtime routine card
activity.text: Make a bedtime card together: brush teeth, make wudhu, recite Ayat al-Kursi with a grown-up, then sleep.

guide.remember: I remember Allah before I sleep.

episodes.title: Bilal and the Big Clean Up
episodes.summary: At the park, Bilal learns that even small actions, like picking up rubbish, can be acts of faith.

guide.before: Ask: what do you do with rubbish when you're out?
talk: What did Bilal see at the park?
Why is picking up rubbish a good deed?
Where else can we help keep things clean?

activity.title: Little litter helpers
activity.text: Take gloves and a bag on your next park visit and pick up three pieces of rubbish together, with a grown-up close by.

guide.remember: Keeping places clean is a good deed.

episodes.title: Jana's Crown
episodes.summary: It's Jana's first day wearing hijab at school. With courage and her family's support, she learns to wear her faith with confidence.

guide.before: Ask: what makes you feel brave?
talk: How did Jana feel on her first day wearing hijab at school?
Who helped her feel confident?
How can we be kind to friends who look or dress differently?

activity.title: Proud of me
activity.text: Draw yourself doing something that shows who you are as a Muslim, like praying, giving salam or wearing hijab, and tell someone about it.

guide.remember: I can be proud of my faith.

episodes.title: The Lost Toy and the Honest Boy
episodes.summary: Sanad finds a lost toy at the park. When his friend Yusuf comes looking for it, Sanad has to choose whether to keep it or give it back.

guide.before: Ask: what would you do if you found something that isn't yours?
talk: What did Sanad find at the park?
Nobody saw him pick it up. Why did he still give it back?
How did Yusuf feel when he got his toy back?

activity.title: Lost and found box
activity.text: Make a small box at home for things that are found, and practise returning each item to its owner.

guide.remember: I am honest and give back what isn't mine.

episodes.title: Ayesha Meets Anger
episodes.summary: Ayesha's little brother knocks down her blocks and Anger shows up. She learns a simple way to calm her big feelings.

guide.before: Ask: what does anger feel like in your body?
talk: What made Ayesha angry?
What did she do to calm down?
What can you do next time you feel angry?

activity.title: Calm-down breaths
activity.text: Practise together: stop, sit down, and take three slow breaths. Then use kind words to say how you feel.

guide.remember: When I feel angry, I stop and breathe.

episodes.title: Ali Lends a Hand
episodes.summary: Ali notices Mama looking tired from the housework and decides to help with the chores.

guide.before: Ask: who does the jobs at home?
talk: What did Ali notice about Mama?
How did Ali help?
What job can you do to help at home this week?

activity.title: Little helper chart
activity.text: Pick one helping job each day this week, like setting the table or tidying toys, and add a sticker to a chart when it's done.

guide.remember: Helping at home is a good deed.

episodes.title: The Lost Kitten
episodes.summary: Khadijah finds a lost kitten in her garden and remembers the Prophet's ﷺ teaching about kindness to animals.

guide.before: Ask: how should we treat animals?
talk: What did Khadijah find in her garden?
How did she help the kitten?
How can we be kind to animals around us?

activity.title: Kindness to animals
activity.text: Put out a shallow dish of water for birds on a warm day, or draw a pet and show how you would look after it.

guide.remember: I am gentle and kind to animals.

episodes.title: Omar Learns Not to Waste Food
episodes.summary: Omar takes more food than he can finish, and learns from his mum and the teachings of the Prophet ﷺ why we don't waste food.

guide.before: Ask: what do we do with food we can't finish?
talk: What happened when Omar took too much food?
Why shouldn't we waste food?
How can we take just what we need?

activity.title: Small portions first
activity.text: At your next meal, start with a small portion and ask for more if you're still hungry. Say Alhamdulillah when you finish.

guide.remember: I take what I need and don't waste food.

episodes.title: بلال والنظافة
episodes.summary: يتعلّم بلال في الحديقة أن جمع القمامة والحفاظ على نظافة المكان من أعمال الإيمان.

guide.before: Ask: what do you do with rubbish when you're out?
talk: What did Bilal see at the park?
Why is picking up rubbish a good deed?
Where else can we help keep things clean?

activity.title: Little litter helpers
activity.text: Take gloves and a bag on your next park visit and pick up three pieces of rubbish together, with a grown-up close by.

guide.remember: Keeping places clean is a good deed.

episodes.title: زينب واليوم الممطر
episodes.summary: يفسد المطر يوم زينب في الحديقة، فتتعلّم كيف تحوّل خيبة الأمل إلى شكرٍ لله.

guide.before: Ask: what do you do when plans change?
talk: How did Zaynab feel when the rain came?
What did her mum remind her about the rain?
What can we still be thankful for on a rainy day?

activity.title: Rainy day thank-yous
activity.text: Next time it rains, look out of the window together and name three good things the rain brings, like flowers, food and water to drink.

guide.remember: When plans change, I still say Alhamdulillah.

episodes.title: أمينة والظلام
episodes.summary: كانت أمينة تخاف من الظلام، حتى علّمتها والدتها قراءة آية الكرسي قبل النوم.

guide.before: Ask: what helps you feel safe at bedtime?
talk: Why was Aminah scared at night?
What did her mum teach her to recite before sleeping?
How did Aminah feel after remembering Allah?

activity.title: Bedtime routine card
activity.text: Make a bedtime card together: brush teeth, make wudhu, recite Ayat al-Kursi with a grown-up, then sleep.

guide.remember: I remember Allah before I sleep.

episodes.title: عائشة تلتقي بالغضب
episodes.summary: يُسقط أخوها الصغير مكعباتها فيأتيها الغضب، فتتعلّم كيف تهدأ وتتحكّم في مشاعرها.

guide.before: Ask: what does anger feel like in your body?
talk: What made Ayesha angry?
What did she do to calm down?
What can you do next time you feel angry?

activity.title: Calm-down breaths
activity.text: Practise together: stop, sit down, and take three slow breaths. Then use kind words to say how you feel.

guide.remember: When I feel angry, I stop and breathe.

episodes.title: علي يمدّ يد العون
episodes.summary: يلاحظ علي أن ماما متعبة من أعمال البيت، فيقرّر أن يساعدها.

guide.before: Ask: who does the jobs at home?
talk: What did Ali notice about Mama?
How did Ali help?
What job can you do to help at home this week?

activity.title: Little helper chart
activity.text: Pick one helping job each day this week, like setting the table or tidying toys, and add a sticker to a chart when it's done.

guide.remember: Helping at home is a good deed.

episodes.title: Alaya and the Thirsty Little Bird
episodes.summary: On a hot explorer day, Alaya and Zaynab find a little bird panting under a bush. With an acorn cup, careful steps and lots of patience, they discover that kindness to even the smallest creature matters.

guide.before: Ask: how do you think animals feel on a very hot day?
talk: What clues helped Alaya and Zaynab realise the bird was thirsty?
Why did Alaya take slower steps the second time she carried the water?
What's one small thing we could do to care for the animals near our home?

activity.title: Bird water dish
activity.text: With a grown-up, set out a shallow dish of fresh water for birds, with a few clean pebbles to perch on. Check it together each day and top it up.

guide.remember: I am kind to animals, big and small.

episodes.title: Uncle Hadi's Story Time: The Little Ant
episodes.summary: Maryam and Haya race to Uncle Hadi's garden and nearly step on a tiny anthill. At story time, Uncle Hadi tells them about a brave little ant from the Qur'an who looked out for her whole colony.

guide.before: Ask: have you ever seen ants marching in a line?
talk: Why did the little ant call out to the other ants?
How did the pebble circle help Maryam and Haya look out for the ants?
Who could you look out for today, and how could you help?

activity.title: Ant watch
activity.text: With a grown-up, find an ant trail outside and quietly watch where the ants go, without touching or blocking their path. Then place a little circle of pebbles or leaves around their tiny home so others notice it, like Maryam and Haya.

guide.remember: I look out for others, even the smallest ones.
